value: **Embodied & Participatory Modeling**: Leverages embodied, mixed-reality, or physical role-play activities to ground learners' sense-making and computational modeling of complex systems. Evidence: "We suggest that tinkering is implicit in movement and changes to movement while exploring embodied models, as students must interpret and react in real time to the system outcomes."
